questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det var vigtigt for mig at vælge et sted der var meget andeledes end København og tempoet der er i byen, det var vigtigt for mig med ro og natur.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Der var gode folk og tydelige hjemmesider til at hjælpe, som guidede en i gennem skridt for skridt

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik udleveret nøglerne til det kollegieværelse jeg var blevet givet på et slags studie/servicecenter

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Generelt var det svært med tilmelding til kurser og få godkendt fag osv synes jeg. Det kræver lidt overblik

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg ansøgte bare og så fik jeg tildelt et kollegieværelse på et kæmpe kollegie udenfor byen

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Man kan godt føle sig lidt isoleret og langt fra byen synes jeg

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg boede på fantoft, og det var ikke lige min stil må jeg sige. Jeg anbefaler alle at finde et værelse/lejlighed inde i byen, selvom at det selvfølgelig virkelig bare er svært når man ingen kender

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er bare altid lidt svært synes jeg, når man er vant til et andet system

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det foregik ret manuelt faktisk. Jeg skrev en mail at jeg gerne ville tilmelde det og det kursus

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Studievejlederen på Bergen universitet hjalp mig godt

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jamen det fejlede jeg i. Jeg modtog ingen beskeder på "absalon" fra mit kursus og så skrev jeg til studievejlederen og spurgte om jeg havde gjort noget forkert, og så fortalte han mig at jeg ikke var tilmeldt korrekt og jeg måtte ansøge om eftertilmeldning. Det var lidt en stressende oplevelse synes jeg, men alt gik fint i sidste ende

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Gå hen til studieinformationen fysisk og få hjælp af dem

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det mindede meget om niveauet på KU, så det var dejligt

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det foregik på samme måde, vi var bare færre i klassen. Det var hold undervisning, samt én byvandring. Vi var omkring 3-10 i klassen der mødte op til undervisning, men det var bare hyggeligt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Tingene og vi. Materialitet og meining. 

Et norsk kursus. Rigtig spændende!

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg anbefaler humanistiske kurser på norsk. Så interessant, og dejligt at dyrke det skandinaviske fællesskab
